definitions.explanation: The main administrative center of an organization, company, or operation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本部|ほんぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The company's headquarters is in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧{本部|ほんぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}された→設置：09750_secchi⟧。
examples.english: A disaster response headquarters was established.

examples.japanese: {本部|ほんぶ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧{本部|ほんぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}った→練る：09751_neru⟧。
examples.english: We developed a strategy at the election headquarters.

examples.japanese: {本部|ほんぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告：03618_houkoku⟧。

notes:
{本部|ほんぶ} is the centre that directs an organisation — a company division, a police force, a political campaign, a disaster response team. It names the command function, so it can be set up temporarily as well as permanently.
